Alex — thanks for the packet and the clear summary. Looping in Monica (Procurement) and Marcus (AP ops) to validate routing. A couple quick clarifying asks so we can provision Ledgify in our vendor registry without delays: 

1) Can you confirm the legal entity exactly as it should appear in our systems (name + any DBA)? You listed "Ledgify, Inc." on the W-9 but we want the canonical string used for contracts.
2) Please confirm whether the remit address is different from the main address on the W-9 (you provided a remit address — good to confirm).
3) PO acceptance: do you accept standard Redwood POs (net 45 by default) or do you require bespoke payment terms? If different, please provide your terms in one line.
4) Are there any specific invoice instructions (PO number placement, remit email, EIN on invoices)?
5) For ACH setup we only store last4 of account number in the registry and require a copy of a voided check or bank letter — can you upload that to the Drive link below or confirm you want AP to proceed using the ACH stub you attached?

Drive upload for secure files: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1LedgifyOnboard (private to Redwood AP)

We should be able to create the vendor record once Monica confirms the mapping fields. Marcus — can you flag anything else we need to collect before vendor creation?

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference

1) Canonical legal name for contracts: "Ledgify, Inc." (no DBA).
2) Remit address for checks is the same as the one I sent (401 Market St, Suite 300, SF, CA 94105).

4) Invoice instructions: Please include PO number on the invoice header and send invoices to invoices@ledgify.com. EIN should be printed on the invoice per our tax team request.

Hi Priya / Alex — thanks for the uploads and confirmation. I reviewed the packet and we have everything we need to start creation, with two small items to close out: 

• Beneficial ownership attestation: because Ledgify is a US C Corp, can you confirm that there are no individual beneficial owners with >25% ownership? A one-line attestation is fine.
• Preferred invoice route: you indicated invoices@ledgify.com — please confirm that this mailbox is actively monitored for AP team processing.

Once we have the ownership attestation and confirm the voided check is in the secure Drive folder, we will create the vendor record and assign a Redwood supplier ID. We will provision PO routing to invoices@ledgify.com and set preferred payment term to Net 45 (per our standard), with a note that Ledgify prefers Net 30. If you would like us to retain Net 30 on your supplier profile, we can request an approval but that will add an additional 7–10 business days.

Thanks,
